scope: Final same-batch RecyclerView versus official ListView, not a quantified before/after optimization gain or a device FPS claim.

source_provenance.source_snapshot_role: Report-generation snapshot only. No final-run source manifest exists. The shared worktree includes concurrent work; these whole-file hashes cannot prove exact sampled source state or isolation.

exploratory_before_manifest.head: 91680417758d3cbd2c6b2c06a99c382e6f5e242d
exploratory_before_manifest.note: Not a controlled final before/after performance baseline; unrelated shared-tree overrides existed.

statistics.selection_policy: All formal samples from all three runs retained; no slow-frame exclusion, favorable-run selection, or post-hoc trimming. Eight warmup frames per leg were excluded by the predefined fixture, not by outcome.
statistics.statistics_policy: Arithmetic mean over raw microseconds. Nearest-rank p50/p95 matching the fixture. Pooled percentiles computed directly over all 144 frames, not averaged run percentiles. Ratio = RecyclerView mean / ListView mean; below 1 favors RecyclerView.
measurement_limits: Headless flutter_test / Debug JIT / Ahem; full jump+pump wall time includes framework and semantics. Not phone Profile FrameTiming, FPS, or input latency.
Actual same content and absolute-offset trajectory. Official cards retain valid itemExtent540 advantage; RecyclerView has no additional fixed item extent.
Semantics enabled, cache0, RV prefetch disabled, photos predecoded, matched per-item repaint boundaries, ABBA order.
Final conclusions compare final RecyclerView with official ListView. Exploratory before/optimized-first logs are not mixed into final three-run before/after improvement evidence.

separate_phase_diagnostic.scope: Separate VM Timeline diagnostic with profiling overhead. Per-frame interval unions; nested inclusive durations not additive; any-thread GC overlap is not a UI-thread pause.

before-validated.log.role: Exploratory and stage validation only; excluded from final pooled results and improvement claims.

optimized-first.log.role: Exploratory and stage validation only; excluded from final pooled results and improvement claims.

core.note: Includes paint-isolation2 and existing offset cases; do not count them again.

targeted_static_analysis.note: No errors reported by the parent; not a repository-wide analysis.

validation.counting_policy: 123+82+31+19+6. Excludes duplicate ABBA rounds, separate profile diagnostic, and overlapping paint/offset checks.

raw_final_data.schema: Each visible row retains position/top/height and replaces its texts/images/icons payload with a short content_id. The dictionary stores sha256 and actual_content once per unique payload. Replace the reference with actual_content to reconstruct the original row.
raw_final_data.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon without whitespace.
